title: Chat component data
description: Group chat. One Chat per app, created by the app with id chat-<appId>. It is shown in its own chat view, never as a card in a group, and the component sits at index 9000 so group reorders do not touch it. Messages are m_<uuidv7 lowercase> keys whose value is a JSON-encoded string of $defs/message. Messages are append-only: write a new key, never edit or delete one. Reactions are react_<messageKey>_<publicKey> keys. Keys starting with _ are layout keys.

v.description: Wire format version, written by the app. Absent means 1.

_title.description: Panel title shown above the component. '' clears it. Example: "Groceries".

_sectionBreak.description: true starts a new visual section, with a bigger gap above and a stronger separator.

_width.description: Preferred width in logical pixels. Default 600, minimum 300.

_spaceAbove.description: Legacy spacing above in pixels, no longer written. When _sectionBreak is absent, a value of 16 or more reads as a section break.

_spaceBelow.description: Legacy spacing below in pixels, no longer written.

^m_[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[.description: One chat message, a JSON-encoded string of $defs/message. The key is m_<uuidv7 lowercase>. Append-only: write a new key, never edit or delete an existing one. sender must be your own public key. Example value: "{\"v\":1,\"sender\":\"<your publicKey>\",\"ts\":1767225600000,\"body\":\"Hi all\"}". Annotation only: '' and future non-JSON values are also stored here.

^react_m_[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f.description: One reaction per member and message, key react_<messageKey>_<publicKey>. The value is a single emoji, '' removes it. You can only write the key ending in your own public key. Example: "👍".

^_.description: Other layout and UI keys starting with _. Any value.

sender.description: Public key of the author. Must be your own public key.

ts.description: Send time in epoch milliseconds. Example: 1767225600000.

body.description: Plain text of the message, up to 4000 characters. Example: "Hi all".

attachments.description: Files attached to the message, up to 10. They reference files that were already uploaded; agents cannot upload files.

bodyFallback.description: true means body is a placeholder the app wrote for an attachment-only message, and the app hides it in favour of the attachments.

id.description: Id of the uploaded file (a UUID).

w.description: Width of an image in pixels, used to lay it out before it loads. Omit for other files.

h.description: Height of an image in pixels, used to lay it out before it loads. Omit for other files.
